name: Poonawalla Fincorp Ltd
title: Poonawalla Fincorp Ltd - 524000 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Poonawalla Fincorp's Q4FY26 shows NIM up to 9.05%, credit cost down to 2.51% and ROA 1.81%, but this is a consumer-lender credit-cost and margin story with no supply-side discipline to speak of.

triggers.label: Disbursement yield 15.56% → 15.96%
triggers.quote: your disbursal yield in Q4 has gone up by 40 basis points

triggers.label: NIM 8.62% → 9.05% QoQ
triggers.quote: Our NIM has expanded sequentially by 43 basis points from an 8.62% in Q3FY26 to 9.05% in Q4FY26

triggers.label: Credit cost 2.62% → 2.51%
triggers.quote: There has been a quarter -on-quarter decline in credit cost from 2.62% to 2.51%

triggers.label: Opex-to-AUM lower by FY27 end
triggers.quote: we have set an internal benchmark to close the next financial year at a lower opex to AUM ratio than our current levels

guidance.quote: we've given a guidance of AUM of 35 -40%
Right up to the 4 quarters , ROA should gradually start moving strength to strength

guidance.value: lower than current levels by FY27 end; quarterly swings of 10-25 bps
guidance.quote: we have set ourselves an internal benchmark to close the next financial year at a lower opex to AUM ratio than our current levels
We will move towards 35% to 40% over the next few quarters

prior_guidance_check.quote: In our Q1FY26 call, we had guided that we will restore 9% NIM levels in three to four quarters. Happy to report back that we have achieved the same in 3 quarters.
We have successfully operationalized 400 gold branches. The commitment we had made , has been met.

red_flags.label: Unsecured book near 50%, management dismisses geopolitical risk
red_flags.quote: we are also almost 50% portfolio is uns ecured

red_flags.label: Evasive on fee income guidance
red_flags.quote: there's no guidance that we give on these things

evasions.quote: there's no guidance that we give on these things
I don't see any risk here
